scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @vaccine/contracts && npm run build --workspace @vaccine/scenario-schema && npm run build --workspace @vaccine/scenario-router && npm run build --workspace @vaccine/credit-guard && npm run build --workspace @vaccine/ui
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @vaccine/api && npm run build --workspace @vaccine/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && tsx --test packages/contracts/src/contracts.test.ts packages/scenario-schema/src/schema.test.ts packages/scenario-schema/src/authoring.test.ts packages/scenario-router/src/router.test.ts packages/credit-guard/src/creditGuard.test.ts apps/api/src/health.test.ts apps/api/src/environment.test.ts apps/api/src/session.test.ts apps/api/src/sessionApi.test.ts apps/api/src/turnOrchestrator.test.ts apps/api/src/rateLimit.test.ts apps/api/src/providers/mockAdapters.test.ts apps/api/src/cache/cacheKey.test.ts apps/api/src/timing.test.ts apps/api/src/behaviorClassifier.test.ts apps/api/src/adaptivePolicy.test.ts apps/api/src/debriefEngine.test.ts apps/api/src/eventLog.test.ts apps/api/src/telephonyAudio.test.ts packages/contracts/src/prismaRealtime.test.ts apps/web/src/healthClient.test.ts apps/web/src/environment.test.ts apps/web/src/viteProxy.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run validate:scenarios && npm run build && npm run secret-scan
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @vaccine/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @vaccine/web
